title: Planeó una masacre escolar con ChatGPT, intervino el FBI y no recibirá ninguna pena

reports.title: Un adolescente planificó con la Inteligencia Artificial matar a sus compañeros de colegio: fue detectado por el FBI y allanado en Quilmes
Cómo descubrió el FBI al chico de 15 años que organizaba con IA una masacre escolar en Quilmes y cuál era su plan
Un adolescente planificó con Inteligencia Artificial matar a sus compañeros: el FBI dio aviso y lo allanaron en Quilmes
Planeó una masacre escolar con ChatGPT, intervino el FBI y no recibirá ninguna pena

summary:
A 15-year-old boy in Quilmes, Argentina, is under investigation after the FBI's legal office in Buenos Aires warned local authorities that he had used ChatGPT to discuss killing his classmates. The alert led the Argentine Federal Police to open a case on 19 August. Detectives identified the teenager and his home, and a judge ordered a raid. Officers seized two cell phones, two pairs of tactical gloves, a camouflage cap, two balaclavas, and protective goggles. The boy had reportedly talked about a school shooting initially planned for 2027, but said he might move it earlier, and showed interest in tactical gear.

The case is being handled by juvenile prosecutor Walter Bruno and Judge Miriam Alcolcel. After the search, the teenager and his parents were summoned to the prosecutor's office, while his identity is being protected. The seized items were placed at the judge's disposal in a case for public intimidation. The article does not say whether the boy has been charged or detained, only that the investigation continues.
title_en: He planned a school massacre with ChatGPT, the FBI intervened and he will receive no punishment
